## Definitions and results

### 1.1 First note [→](/notes/t/alpha/first.qmd){.summary-src title="Open the note"}

::: {.summary-item .k-def .scope-block data-kind="def" data-item="t/alpha/first" data-courses="demo" data-label="Definition: Widget"}
[Definition]{.summary-kind} Widget [→](/notes/t/alpha/first.qmd#def-widget){.summary-src title="1.1 First note"}

A *widget* is a thing with
$$ w = 1. $$
:::

::: {.summary-item .k-thm .scope-block data-kind="result" data-item="t/alpha/first" data-courses="demo" data-label="Theorem: Widget theorem"}
[Theorem]{.summary-kind} Widget theorem [→](/notes/t/alpha/first.qmd#thm-widget){.summary-src title="1.1 First note"}

Every widget is a widget.
:::
